name: Bombay Coated and Special Steels
summary: Bombay Coated and Special Steels processes coated and flat steel (slitting, cut-to-length, shearing, embossing) for appliance, engineering, automotive and electrical makers from four plants in Maharashtra, Rajasthan and Andhra Pradesh, and is an authorised service partner of JSW Steel Coated Products. Revenue grew from ₹755 cr in FY24 to ₹1,267 cr in FY26, but profit rose only 6.5% in FY26 to ₹30.5 cr and the net margin is thin at 2.4%. The whole ₹183 cr issue is fresh money, but about 68% of it goes to repaying debt; debt to equity was 2.78 before the issue. At the upper band the post-issue P/E is about 16.9x, below the median of the listed peers named in the RHP.

fh1.finding: Revenue rose from ₹755.3 cr (FY24) to ₹1,266.8 cr (FY26), a CAGR of about 29.5%.

fh2.finding: Revenue grew every year: ₹755 cr, ₹1,056 cr, ₹1,267 cr (FY24–FY26).

fh3.finding: Debt to equity was 2.78 in FY26 (borrowings ₹338.5 cr vs net worth ₹121.6 cr).

fh4.finding: Borrowings rose 45% (₹234 cr to ₹338 cr) while total income rose 66% over FY24–FY26.

fh5.finding: Net worth rose every year: ₹54.4 cr, ₹83.1 cr, ₹121.6 cr (FY24–FY26).

fh6.finding: Operating cash flow was ₹10.2 cr in FY26, only about a third of the ₹30.5 cr profit.

pr1.finding: Profit after tax grew 6.5% in FY26, to ₹30.5 cr, while revenue grew about 20%.

pr2.finding: Net margin slipped from 2.80% (FY24) to 2.72% (FY25) and 2.40% (FY26).

pr3.finding: Return on net worth was 25.1% in FY26, helped by the small equity base.

pr4.finding: ROCE was 16.4% in FY26, down from 18.8% in FY25.

pr5.finding: Peer margins were not found in public sources.

va1.finding: Post-issue P/E of about 16.9x vs a peer median of 31.0x (BMW Industries 15.0x, Manaksia Coated 31.0x, Shiv Aum 98.5x).

va2.finding: Post-issue price to book of about 1.7x (₹515 cr market cap vs ₹305 cr post-issue net worth) vs a peer median of 4.0x.

va3.finding: Peer market cap to sales figures were not found in public sources.

va4.finding: No details of pre-IPO share issues or transfers were found in public sources.

pg1.finding: Promoters hold 63.03% after the issue, down from 97.78%.

pg2.finding: No information on pledged promoter shares was found.

pg3.finding: Related-party transaction figures were not found in public sources.

pg4.finding: No information on regulatory action against promoters was found.

is1.finding: The entire ₹183 cr issue is fresh; there is no offer for sale.

is2.finding: The issue is about 35.5% of the ₹515 cr post-issue market cap.

is3.finding: No selling shareholders, because there is no offer for sale.

up1.finding: Only ₹15.8 cr (8.6%) buys equipment, and it is equipment already in use under a lease; nothing funds new capacity.

up2.finding: ₹125 cr, or 68.3% of the issue, goes to repaying borrowings.

up3.finding: General corporate purposes take ₹42.3 cr, or 23.1% of the issue.

up4.finding: Public sources don't say whose loans are being repaid.

lg1.finding: Litigation amounts were not found in public sources.

lg2.finding: No information on criminal or regulatory cases was found.

lg3.finding: Contingent liabilities were not found in public sources.

rk1.finding: Customer concentration among a few appliance and engineering makers is called out as a risk; exact shares are not published.

rk2.finding: JSW Steel Coated Products supplies most of its raw material, which is called out as a key risk.

rk3.finding: Incorporated in December 2019, so under 7 years of operating history.

rk4.finding: Auditor remarks were not found in public sources.
